systems.country_label: Parish Development Management Information System (also Parish-Based Management Information System, PBIS)
systems.owner: Ministry of Local Government sets up and coordinates it; Ministry of ICT and National Guidance funded under PDM
systems.tiers: parishes, PDM SACCOs and Local Governments; loan records are to be updated in it

systems.country_label: Tablets dispatched to all districts for PDM
systems.owner: supplied by UBOS to the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance, distributed through the Ministry of Local Government
systems.tiers: 24,247 tablets (24,250 by the Treasury circular) sent to districts in December 2024 for Parish Chiefs, PDM SACCO executives, Community Development Officers, District Statisticians, District ICT Officers and OWC coordinators

systems.country_label: Wendi, digital payment platform used by Government banks
systems.tiers: PDM SACCOs and beneficiaries through agents; 5,373 parishes in 121 LGs had no agent

note: An audit of the Parish Development Model in 176 Local Governments and KCCA: it states tablets handed over and a parish information system, and nothing on the connection of any local government office. The passages are mostly appendix tables listed by local government.
